`class TransformNodeEffect`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEffect<Node>`](/reference/effects/nodeeffect/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.effect.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TransformNodeEffect.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/effect/impl/TransformNodeEffect.java)

Moves, rotates or scales the drawing of a node and its children without changing the layout.

![A grey rectangle rotated by 20 degrees](/captures/catalog-effects-transformnodeeffect.webp)

## Description

The effect applies a [`Transformation`](/reference/drawing/transformation/) to the model-view matrix while the node and its children draw.
A rotation or a scale without a pivot of its own turns or scales around the center of the node.
Its priority is `-100`, the lowest of the built-in effects, so it moves the shadow, the mask and the pixel effects with the node.
The node still receives the mouse at its layout position.

## Property details

<a id="TransformNodeEffect-property-transformation"></a>

### transformation

- `this transformation(Transformation transformation)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Transformation getTransformation()` 

**Default:** set at creation

Operations applied to the drawing of the node.
A rotation that reads a `Supplier` for its angle follows it, so an animation turns the node without replacing the transformation.

## Method details

<a id="TransformNodeEffect-method-draw"></a>

### draw

`void draw(Node node, Runnable body)` 

Saves the model-view matrix, applies the transformation around the center of the node, draws the node, then restores the matrix, even when the drawing throws.
